# Therizo Property and Development Corporation

> Boutique Nigerian real estate firm serving diaspora investors with verified titles, transparent numbers, and disciplined due diligence across Lagos, Abuja, and Port Harcourt.

Therizo curates residential and commercial properties in Nigeria, prioritising documented ownership and defensible pricing. We publish investment guides, an ROI calculator, and location intelligence for serious buyers.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Therizo's verified property offering for diaspora investors.
- [Properties](/properties): Curated listings with verified titles across Lagos, Abuja, and Port Harcourt.
- [ROI Calculator](/calculator): Estimate rental yield, cap rate, and payback for Nigerian properties.
- [Our Standard](/our-standard): How Therizo vets titles, ownership, and pricing before listing.
- [Team](/team): Leadership and consultants across Nigerian and diaspora markets.
- [Contact](/contact): Speak with a Therizo consultant.
- [Materials Supply](/materials-supply): Building materials supply for contractors and developers.
- [Abuja Diaspora Starter Kit](/abuja-starter-kit): Playbook for diaspora investors buying in Abuja.
- [Submit Property](/submit-property): Owner funnel to list a property with Therizo.

## Locations

- [Lagos](/locations/lagos): Lekki, Victoria Island, Ikoyi, and growth corridors.
- [Abuja](/locations/abuja): Maitama, Asokoro, Wuse, and FCT growth areas.
- [Port Harcourt](/locations/port-harcourt): GRA, Trans Amadi, and Rivers State.
